messages:
devon: FYI Silverline hit a VPC peering regression during a routine topology change. Tenant isolation observed — one host couldn't reach the inference cluster and customers saw 5xx. Starting a postmortem/action-item thread.

sre-bot: Alert 2198764320: vpc-peering-flap detected for tenant 'silverline' — isolation_count=3, duration=00:02:45

maria: Thanks. Any initial root cause hypotheses? overlapping CIDR, BGP flap, or MTU?

devon: Initial triage: onprem border router performed a route overwrite during maintenance, and we saw MTU mismatch on the kube-proxy host causing TCP fragmentation/drops. That amplified a brief BGP session reset into a partial tenant isolation. Logs pasted below.

oliver: I'll take networking remediation and runbook updates. Plan to draft checklist and mitigations. ETA initial runbook update by Thu EOD.

aj: I can own infra e2e harness that simulates peering churn + CI job. Need ~2 days to add scenarios and a safe canary.

tara: CS/AM looped in. Need comms timeline — what was SLA impact window?

devon: Customer impact window: 2026-03-20T14:12Z -> 14:15Z. A subset of API calls returned 5xx; no data integrity or exfil detected. Notifying sec/legal for compliance record.

oliver: Concrete action list (quick):
- ACTION-01 (oliver): runbook updates + peering checklist (due 2026-03-25)
- ACTION-02 (aj): CI e2e harness for peering churn (due 2026-03-24)
- ACTION-03 (maria): isolation triage playbook for on-prem (due 2026-03-26)
- ACTION-04 (devon): postmortem doc draft (due 2026-03-22)

maria: For ACTION-03 I'll include specific tests for MTU mismatch, asymmetric routes, and automated route-propagation checks. Will also add a triage table for quick decisioning.

aj: Snippet I'll wire into the harness to simulate a peering flap (can be turned into a Chaostest):
```
# simulate BGP/peering flap on border node (dev harness)
iptables -I INPUT -m state --state NEW -p tcp --dport 179 -j DROP
sleep 30
iptables -D INPUT -m state --state NEW -p tcp --dport 179 -j DROP
```
CI job name: peering-flap-e2e. Will link PR.

oliver: Recommend adding lightweight BGP session health probe on border nodes and a metric 'bgp_session_down_total' with a runbook step to failover to alternate peering. Also add a preflight for onboarding that prevents overlapping CIDRs.

tara: For external comms: draft email to Silverline and internal exec note. Devon, when will the postmortem draft be ready so we can align messaging?

devon: I'll publish a draft to the postmortem tracker by Mon 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. Tagging @maria @aj for technical review.

sre-bot: Reminder: create JIRA ticket per action, include owner + due date. Use label 'incident/containment-regression-silverline'.

maria: Creating ACTION-03 ticket now (INC-5892) and linking this thread.

aj: Opened infra PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 (CI harness + job). Marking as WIP. @oliver can you review?

oliver: Reviewing PR-4123, will leave comments. Plan a canary rollout in Dedicated pool first, not global.

devon: Reconvene status sync: 2026-03-23 10:00 PT. If owners need to move dates update JIRA and ping here.

tara: Added comms milestone and customer notification window to calendar. :white_check_mark:

maria: Quick follow: we should add an automated audit in the private deployment onboarding flow to reject overlapping CIDR assignments; that would have prevented this specific route overwrite.

oliver: Agreed — ACTION-05 (oliver + infra): CIDR validation and UI guardrail on onboarding flow (due 2026-04-01).

devon: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread for now; please keep updates in the JIRA tickets and ping #incidents for blockers.
